tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the אקווה פלו catalog (Israel) for water filters, UV lamps, descaling kits and fridge filters. Use when the user names a device (Tami 4 Family, Primo, Bubble Bar, Edge, Electra bar, Eden Pure, LG or Samsung fridge) or a need. Returns name, price in ILS including VAT, stock and URL, and shows

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full details of one product: description, price, stock, SKU, compatible devices as written by the store, FAQ and an add-to-cart URL. Use after search_products when the user asks about a specific product.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List product categories with ids and product counts. Use to narrow search_products by category or to show the user what the store sells.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare two to five products side by side on price, stock and category. Use when the user is choosing between an original and a compatible filter or between lamp models.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Build a link that fills the store cart with the chosen products and quantities, and show an order summary view. It does not place an order or take payment: the shopper opens the link, reviews the cart and pays on the site. Use when the user has decided what to buy.
